answer: Admission runs through ChainGate, a verifier that checks each cold-chain logger serial and its traceable calibration certificate against the lab register before a shipment can claim a payout. The penalty trigger is a duplicated certificate number or one logger reporting two shipments at once, which voids the batch and forfeits the posted escrow. A logger costs 180 dollars, calibration 240, and a courier run 90, so N fakes cost N times 510 dollars plus N attended runs. An echo in the hold, a long voyage, or a bridge crossing changes nothing, because the serial is read at every handoff.
